# Acme Enterprise Operations Record

Paolo Rinaldi is the Director of European Operations at Acme Robotics.
Paolo owns the Atlas warehouse modernization program.
The Atlas program launched on 15 January 2026.
The approved Atlas budget is EUR 4.2 million.
The program operates in Berlin, Milan, and Rotterdam.
Paolo reports to Chief Operating Officer Elena Fischer.
Elena approved the phase-two rollout on 3 March 2026.
The phase-two rollout must finish before 30 September 2026.
The Berlin warehouse currently processes 18,000 parcels per day.
The Atlas target is 25,000 parcels per day by the end of 2026.
The safety policy requires two trained operators for every autonomous loading zone.
Acme Robotics selected Northstar Systems as the primary robotics supplier.
The supplier agreement with Northstar Systems expires on 31 December 2027.
The operational review occurs every Monday at 09:00 Europe/Berlin time.
Paolo is accountable for publishing the weekly operational review.
The risk register identifies battery overheating as the highest-severity technical risk.
The mitigation owner for battery overheating is engineer Maya Chen.
Maya must publish thermal test evidence before the phase-two authority gate.
The program decision log is the authoritative source for rollout approvals.
No autonomous loading zone may enter production without a signed safety receipt.
